items.summary: CFO recommendation: retain and conditionally approve the single bounded, no-spend SEO change for stinkyleftfoot.com as a learning experiment, subject to existing validation and rollback gates. Do not claim revenue, contribution margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, forecast, or causal lift. The supplied baseline is 988 impressions, 2 clicks, position 8.9, and 0 conversions; the 1.2% CTR target is measurable but not a revenue proxy. Amazon revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, all in an aggregate provider row; site-attributed income is $0, so site revenue claims are unsupported. AI usage covers 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-02 with $48.94121895 across 292 calls and 20 observed sites versus 40 expected; allocation is incomplete. Contribution margin is not calculable because revenue and AI spend are not period-aligned, AI coverage is incomplete, infrastructure/domain costs and budgets are absent, and aggregate commission cannot be assigned. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because spend cannot be linked to this page change or to a causal outcome window. Minimum measurement: use matching revenue and cost periods, complete per-site AI and infrastructure/domain cost allocation, retain registered tracking IDs, and record experiment exposure, incremental clicks/sessions/conversions, and attributable commission for the same change window. Pushback: SEO impressions, clicks, sessions, shipped output, and proposal counts are operating or vanity metrics until tied to attributable outcomes and cost.
